source: Planet & Narrative's SS2 archetype palette, locked 23 Oct 2026 on ticket 775 (spec #774, GD lock on Campaign Scaling 23 Oct 20:20): name parts in the ledger voice keyed to the act colour, the eight biome looks (hue and ground motif, each pair distinct), and Progression's SS2-B new-content set (23 Oct; ticket 780 writes the behaviours and completes the set). Progression's fifth row, the 'Void glass' ore family of planet 2.5, is not here: the fail-on-recolour check refuses it, as the first system's exotic family (Hollow's signature from planet 33) is already named Voidglass; ticket 780 names its replacement, and planet 2.5's slot stays empty until it does. Written once; every system from the second draws from it by seed and nothing is authored per planet. Prefixes are keyed to the #141 act at the planet's campaign index; the Foothold+ prefixes serve the foothold.heavy act, since no system past the first ever holds planet 1's act.
